title: Stored neural soma sold where it lies, at Node Beta, into the station's soma bid
note: Node Beta's soma bid stood at 670 x 2 at 11:56 UTC and read 0 at 12:31 UTC (ledger.py prices voidborn_neural_soma); 10 haulers store 16 soma there (data/stock/storage.json, 12:21 to 12:26 UTC). Floor 500 cr. Written by Apollo, 2026-11-16 13:00 UTC (orders.log ENT-014, block APOLLO (1): sell the stored soma where it lies as the pools refill). Uses the circuit runner's withdraw step (Zero, commit 6f643ec): at a stop that also sells the item it withdraws only what the bid takes at its best price, so nothing withdrawn stays aboard. requires.stored sends only a pilot whose own storage there holds the good; requires.bid closes the route while a book read within the hour shows the bid gone or under its floor. Nothing is bought; a run that finds the bid gone costs the hop's fuel (about 26 cr a jump). A test: one ship until its first RESULT line.
